light.limitation: One robust distant mirror direction, fitted to all compatible training reflection candidates because the frozen patch flags supply no yellow candidates. Descriptive diagnostic only; flags and normals are conditional. Unknown-context reflections are not certified black bodies. No BRDF or radiometric fit; no geometry is refitted to this result.

contact.method: Analytic support-function separating planes for convex filled outer envelopes; bounding spheres exclude all other pairs. Sufficient floating-point witnesses, not interval-arithmetic formal proof.
